検証: test -f .github/workflows/watchdog.yml && grep -qE '^ *schedule:' .github/workflows/watchdog.yml && grep -q 'check_heartbeat_fresh.py' .github/workflows/watchdog.yml; bash -c 'printf "{\"beat\": 1, \"at\": \"2000-01-01T00:00:00Z\", \"writer\": \"heart\"}" > /tmp/hb-stale.json; python3 ops/check_heartbeat_fresh.py --file /tmp/hb-stale.json; test $? -eq 1'; bash -c 'python3 -c "import json,datetime;json.dump({\"beat\":1,\"at\":datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\"),\"writer\":\"heart\"},open(\"/tmp/hb-fresh.json\",\"w\"))"; python3 ops/check_heartbeat_fresh.py --file /tmp/hb-fresh.json'; python3 -c "import inspect, sys, importlib.util as u; spec=u.spec_from_file_location('chf','ops/check_heartbeat_fresh.py'); m=u.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); s=inspect.getsource(m); sys.exit(0 if 'stale_seconds' in s else 1)"
